dedupe_keys.name: nuclear winter data commons processing workflows

description: The public GitHub repository supplies Python and R scripts, manifests and documentation for retrieving, aggregating and standardizing Nuclear Winter Data Commons outputs. Its API identifies an MIT licence. The README describes a path from OSF model outputs to aggregated Excel products, then an R cleaning pipeline; a Python environment and R renv lock file are present. The companion OSF project contains global and regional scenario fields, so processing coverage depends on which model outputs are selected. This tool can help prepare extreme climate and food-system scenario fields for infrastructure simulation, especially coupled food-supply and emergency-service studies. It is a data-processing workflow, not a climate or nuclear-conflict simulator itself. The maintainers explicitly say download, extraction and aggregation steps are works in progress and may require manual relocation of extracted files. The README's download script calls for an OSF token, although public OSF metadata were accessible without one. The code was not cloned, installed or run; end-to-end reproducibility was not verified.
name: Nuclear Winter Data Commons processing workflows
